title: Vue 2, read like a tree

specimen.common: Vue 2 (vuejs/vue), the archived line, cut at HEAD
specimen.note: This history starts in April 2016 with a fresh init for Vue 2.0, so the pith is already a busy quarter. The rings narrow after 2.6, a scar marks the 2.7 TypeScript port, and the bark is a handful of commits after end of life. One long ray runs almost the whole way: Evan You wrote 2,575 of 3,580 commits.

epilogue: Thirty-five quarterly rings. Vue 3 lives in a different repository, vuejs/core, so this trunk stops growing at end of life rather than turning into the next version.
